articles.title: Russia using North Korean missiles to strike Ukraine, Zelensky says
articles.description: Ukraine's president says strikes in Zaporizhzhia - which killed at least six and injured 19 - involved ballistic missiles from Russia's ally.

articles.title: Houthis reportedly kill four in first deadly attack since start of Iran war
articles.description: The attack was reportedly carried out by Iranian proxy on a small cargo ship, as tensions in region over the US-Iran conflict remain high.

articles.title: British couple jailed in Iran end hunger strike after several months, family says
articles.description: A British couple jailed in Iran over alleged spying have ended a three-month-long hunger strike against their sentence, their son has said.
